body.resource_hint: Let A_sym be the field-degree-completed commutative local-jet symbol algebra Q((lambda))[Z,Z^-1][[J]] with zero-jet augmentation. The Eq. (16) symbol O=lambda^-1 Z exp(lambda varphi) is a unit with explicit inverse lambda Z^-1 exp(-lambda varphi). The symbol Y=Z^-1 exp(-lambda varphi)F, F=Box(varphi)+lambda(dvarphi)^2, has epsilon(Y)=0, hence is not a unit. A regular unital automorphism preserves units, so it cannot exchange O and Y up to an invertible normalization. This also rules out a filtration-continuous quantum automorphism with that regular classical symbol, but not a singular/unbounded CCR correspondence. Localizing at F removes the zero-jet chart; doubling changes the source theory.
